kv.memory.agora-blob-token-free: Agora blob tokens (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 A): peer blob GET does not check token; a blob is held under every token it was uploaded/replicated/pulled/pinned for, charged to each; pins attach to any held copy; after DM host handover old blobs stay at old relays 30 days then members re-upload.
kv.memory.agora-broadcast-decision: Agora broadcast channels (Mark 2026-10-16, option B unified): encrypted under CO-distributed channel content key via Space endpoint; public channels publish key in public Space state. Reason: no confidential large-audience channel existed (community mode caps 500, non-speakers can't read).
kv.memory.agora-broadcasters-public: Agora broadcasters list (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 A): broadcasters DIDs exempt from the Mirroring rule (3.4); ARCHITECTURE 9 records that a public broadcast channel's public view names every DID that may post.
kv.memory.agora-channelid: Agora channel identity (Mark 2026-10-16): exporter context = MLS group_id; records/Space state use random 16-byte channelID; DMs named by group ID; no channelCID.
kv.memory.agora-commit-authz: Agora commit authorization (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 A): winner chosen by MLS validity only; Space-state authorization checked afterwards, member refetches state head before treating as policy violation (4.5).
kv.memory.agora-commit-winner: Agora commit winner (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 A): sequencer log is sole referee; first valid Commit per epoch in stamp order wins whether or not published; gaps filled from log; applier republishes unpublished winner; no clocks (drops 10 s window and 15 s hold).
kv.memory.agora-credentials: Agora badges/credentials (Mark 2026-10-17): LeafNode extension agora_credentials carries a list of {media type, bytes} credentials (VC-JOSE/COSE, SD-JWT VC, mdoc, etc.), opaque to Agora; clients verify formats they support; a credential counts only if its subject DID equals the leaf's DID; issuer trust is client/managed policy; omitted from published KeyPackages by default (opt-in), added via self Update after joining; relays never see it.
kv.memory.agora-credentials-defaults: Agora credentials defaults (Mark 2026-10-17): cap 8 entries/8192 bytes; malformed/oversized ignored (never invalidates leaf); strict subject DID match (key-only bindings like typical mdoc do not count); no holder proof required (leaf signature binds), local policy MAY require KB-JWT.
kv.memory.agora-d1-envelope: Agora D1 (Mark 2026-10-16): payloads are typed bytes {type, contentType, body}; signatures over exact bytes; no JSON-LD canonicalization; JSON-LD is one content type among others.
kv.memory.agora-d2-sequencer: Agora D2 (Mark 2026-10-16): JMAP types are single-author (replicated per-member stores, no server) or sequenced (blind per-community sequencer stamps order on encrypted ops; clients validate). Sequencer reads nothing.
kv.memory.agora-d3-realtime: Agora D3 (Mark 2026-10-16): slow real-time updates via relays as MLS messages; fast (10-60 Hz) via WebRTC data channels on the call path, E2EE with exporter keys, SFU blind.
kv.memory.agora-d4-vtc: Agora D4 (Mark 2026-10-16): Agora §6 is VTC source of truth; jmap-vtc ring/schedule/lobby/policy/breakout become MLS group messages (client or CO-bot enforced).
kv.memory.agora-d5-profile: Agora D5 (Mark 2026-10-16): Agora writes a jmap-family profile; draft-change suggestions go in agora notes only; never edit ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec without Mark.
kv.memory.agora-d6-jws: Agora D6 (Mark 2026-10-16): out-of-group signatures are JWS detached/unencoded payload (RFC 7515 + 7797), Ed25519 (RFC 8037), over exact bytes.
kv.memory.agora-d7-jmapchat: Agora D7 (Mark 2026-10-16): jmap-chat Message objects are Agora's chat format; Agora keeps only plumbing types.
kv.memory.agora-did-methods: Agora DID methods (Mark 2026-10-16): did:webvh default; did:plc and did:key opt-in by individuals; did:key users copy key across devices, self-backup only, clients warn; did:key KP pointer via Pkarr; COs may restrict methods per Space.
kv.memory.agora-didkey-devices: did:key multi-device (Mark 2026-10-16): copy identity key, but each device has its own MLS leaf key vouched by an identity-key-signed binding (RFC 9420 unique leaf keys); no per-device revocation.
kv.memory.agora-dm-bogus-key-fix: Agora DM bogus key (Mark 2026-10-17, SC-3 A): issuee DELETEs a replaced key only after a Relay in the new relays accepted a Subscribe to the new key's channelToken; members reject a same-host agora_admission change whose committer is not a host's user (checked via KeyPackageEndpoint origin); key_epoch need only differ (distinct seed,keyEpoch), drop the increase rule for DM groups.
kv.memory.agora-dm-compliance-ext: Agora DM loggers (Mark 2026-10-17, SC-2 A): GroupContext extension agora_compliance (0xF0A4) lists logger and recorder DIDs; regulated member's client sets it in the same Commit as the logger Add; joiners get it in the Welcome; other GCEs copy it unchanged; trust = committer's MLS signature.
kv.memory.agora-dm-host-keyepoch: Agora DM host keyEpoch (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 B): a new host's admission key supersedes every key of the previous host regardless of keyEpoch; keyEpoch ordering applies only among keys of one host; old tokens kept only for history.
kv.memory.agora-dm-host-move: Agora DM host move (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 B): any member except a compliance logger/recorder may move a DM to its own identity host at any time (DMMembers creation + GroupContextExtensions); not a policy violation; locked-out member SHOULD do so. Removes lowest-leaf enforcement and admissionHostDID authentication issues.
kv.memory.agora-dm-key-cap: Agora DM key cap (Mark 2026-10-17, SC-4 B 7 days; FB-1 A): once a rotation Commit has won, the new key's issuee sends the host a committed confirmation (POST <host>/v1/agora/admission-key/<groupID>/<keyEpoch>/committed); the host deregisters every earlier key of that group 7 days after that confirmation; without confirmation earlier keys stay until their issuees DELETE them or are offboarded.
kv.memory.agora-dm-key-in-group: Agora DM admission key in GroupContext (Mark 2026-10-17, MLS-SoT C): DM admission host keeps no member list and serves no members; it generates/registers the key and gives it only to its own user, whose client commits a GroupContextExtensions with agora_admission_host + agora_admission_key (seed, keyEpoch, relays). New members get it in the Welcome; host's user rotates after any Commit removing a DID; host move = one GCE with new host+key. Supersedes agora-dmmembers-seq, agora-dm-correction, agora-dm-creation, agora-dm-same-host; DMMembers deleted.
kv.memory.agora-dm-no-add-consent: Agora DM add consent dropped (Mark 2026-10-17, MLS-SoT C): any DM member may add anyone with no approval; AddApproval type, consentModel and 4.6.1 consent rules deleted; recipients protected by message requests (4.6.3); controlled membership = private Space channel.
kv.memory.agora-dm-no-descriptor: Agora DMGroupDescriptor deleted (Mark 2026-10-17, MLS-SoT A): membership and logger presence read from the ratchet tree; host's user = member whose identity host (KeyPackageEndpoint origin) equals agora_admission_host origin; admissionHostDID, createdBy, consentModel gone; DMComplianceAuditEntry uses epoch + tree_hash.
kv.memory.agora-dm-removal: Agora DM removal (Mark 2026-10-17): any DM member can remove any other member, no consent or authority; host accepts removal DMMembers from any listed DID; compliance loggers/recorders still never removable. Controlled membership = use a private Space channel (room).
kv.memory.agora-dm-withdraw-limit: Agora DM key withdrawal (Mark 2026-10-17, A): a removed host's user can deregister the DM admission key at once, stranding the group; accepted limit recorded in 12 (members start a new group).
kv.memory.agora-doorkey-B: Agora door key (Mark 2026-10-16, option B): CO-issued random channel admission key, registered with agreement relays, served to authenticated members by the Space endpoint, rotated on removals; DMs via initiator's identity host; shared channels via home CO; replaces exporter-derived keys + countersign (Q1).
kv.memory.agora-format-open: Agora payload/package format is open to redesign (Mark 2026-10-16: 'we are still specwriting'); no compatibility constraints. Goal: carry any JSON-LD data and especially JMAP-shaped objects from Mark's draft-atwood-jmap-* family (plain JSON, no @context) in ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec.
kv.memory.agora-gateways-profile: Agora gateways (Mark 2026-10-17, A): Matrix gateway mechanics (spec 9.2) move to non-normative profiles/gateways.md (also future Slack/Teams); core 9 keeps MIMI interop (cleaned: drop Agora content format mode, mimi-content canonical in MIMI groups, current draft versions), a rule that any gateway is a CO component disclosed to members before messages flow, and the unencryptedRemote flag.
kv.memory.agora-historical: ~/GIT/Agora (nie fork, prototype code) renamed to ~/GIT/Agora-historical on 2026-10-16. Frozen; Agora revival is spec-only in ~/PROJECT/agora. GitHub remote MarkAtwood/Agora unchanged.
kv.memory.agora-ipfs: Agora IPFS stance (Mark 2026-10-17, option A): IPFS-compatible not IPFS-dependent: UnixFS/CAR chunking, Bitswap among known peers only (no public DHT announcements for private content), public content may go on public IPFS, IPFS optional for relays/clients, always verify by CID.
kv.memory.agora-mimi-future: Agora MIMI (Mark 2026-10-17, A): no native MIMI interop in core for now; treated as a future option documented in profiles/gateways.md ('path to native MIMI': CO-side hub/follower, hub = channel sequencer when Agora hosts, foreign hub orders when follower, relays never take part, mimi-content mapping, ID mismatch). Core 9 keeps only the gateway rule (CO component, disclosed before messages flow) and unencryptedRemote. Ordering decision deferred until MIMI is needed.
kv.memory.agora-no-payments: Agora first ship: NO money or cryptocurrency handling (Mark, 2026-10-16) — distracting. Payment material lives in attic/relay-economics.md. RelayServiceAgreement stays (separation contract) minus price/fee fields. PoW spam deterrence kept as non-monetary.
kv.memory.agora-parlance-urn: Parlance types on Agora use urn:parlance: (Mark 2026-10-16), treated as registered; Parlance owns the vocabulary, not Substrate.
kv.memory.agora-q1-vouch: Agora Q1 (Mark 2026-10-16, option A): CO registration service countersigns every epoch accessKeyAnnouncement (closes removed-member forgery race). External crypto review still required before implementation.
kv.memory.agora-q2-admission: Agora Q2 (Mark 2026-10-16, option A): relays never authenticate client identity; rate limits by network address/token + optional PoW under load; DID login handshake deleted. Privacy Pass only as future extension.
kv.memory.agora-q3-kp: Agora Q3 (Mark 2026-10-16, option B): KeyPackages live with whoever runs the user's identity (employer provisioning service, or user-chosen host); found via DID-doc KeyPackageEndpoint; relays hold none.
kv.memory.agora-q4-push: Agora Q4 (Mark 2026-10-16, option A): push on by default; content-free wake-ups, relay jitter+coalescing, CO may run own proxy, users may opt out.
kv.memory.agora-q5-discovery: Agora Q5 (Mark 2026-10-16): discovery records signed by whoever they describe; relays never author Space/user records; only public Spaces advertise; directories list only CO-signed records.
kv.memory.agora-q6-billing-did: Agora Q6 decided 2026-10-16 (Mark chose option b): RelayServiceAgreement is signed by a CO billing DID that never appears in Space records; names no Space/channel; private, not gossiped; coverage = AccessChainRegistration of first-epoch access keys via CO registration service (SHOULD batch + delay). Mark intends COs to run many Spaces, which is what gives each Space its anonymity set at the relay.
kv.memory.agora-recording-consent: Agora recording consent (Mark 2026-10-16, option B): compliance grants = disclosure + participation is consent, no veto; operational grants = explicit per-participant acknowledgement before that user's media is sent. Per-person crypto exclusion rejected (group-wide media keys; members can re-record anyway).
kv.memory.agora-relay-bitswap: Agora relay Bitswap (Mark 2026-10-17, review3 A): no Relay-to-Relay Bitswap; relays exchange blobs only over the Peer API; Bitswap for private ciphertext only among a user's own devices and the CO archive. Narrows agora-ipfs 'known peers'.
kv.memory.agora-self-group-spaces: Agora SpaceMembership (Mark 2026-10-17, MLS-SoT A): the user's Space list lives in a self-group GroupContext extension changed by GroupContextExtensions; new devices get it in the Welcome; v counter, tie-breaks, left tombstones and send-before-add ordering deleted.
kv.memory.agora-sequencer-replacement: Agora sequencer replacement (Mark 2026-10-17, FC-4 A): the Space state change naming a new sequencer carries per channel the closing head (stream, n, stamp hash) of the old DID's commit stream, chosen by the CO; old-DID stamps count only up to that head; new sequencer stamps only streams of tokens registered after the change; missing positions at or below head from old log if reachable, else relay history. Mirrors the operation-stream 'after' rule.
kv.memory.agora-stable-did: Agora employer DID naming (Mark 2026-10-16, option A'): localIdentifier MUST be stable, never reassigned, MUST NOT derive from name/email/UPN; org picks source (employee ID, IdP immutable ID, random). Rationale is operational stability of compliance/audit keys, not anonymity (corporate IDs aren't anonymous). alsoKnownAs flow kept only for domain migration.
kv.memory.agora-translog: Agora relay transparency log (Mark 2026-10-16, option C): dropped entirely, matching nie. Do not re-add as protocol feature, guide practice or manifest field.
kv.memory.agora-urn: Treat urn:agora: as a registered URN namespace (Mark 2026-10-16); do not raise RFC 8141 registration again.
kv.memory.agora-ux-musts: Agora UX MUSTs (Mark 2026-10-17): normative MUSTs never constrain user agent UX (display, notification, prompts, rendering) since they cannot be enforced on commercial/OSS clients; use SHOULD/MAY. Keep MUST for wire behavior, verification, compliance capture, send-gates for legal notices (plus one MUST present per notice), and anti-spoofing rules (bidi isolation, raw HTML, untrusted server text, no directory source added because a protocol message names it). Applied per notes/ux-musts.md; Matrix gateway gets a no-E2EE boolean field.
kv.memory.corundum-flexible: CORUNDUM is not fixed (Mark 2026-10-16): it can change to align with Agora (signing, identity, key custody). Frame Corundum fit decisions as change Corundum / change Agora / keep both.
kv.memory.jmap-drafts-editable: Mark 2026-10-16: jmap-chat-spec drafts may now be edited (applying notes/jmap-draft-suggestions.md); ask before committing there; Agora-only overrides not applied to drafts unless asked.
